privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Read Oversea Store's privacy policy and data collection practices.
privacy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy.legalNotice: Requires formal legal review before production deployment.

overview.heading: 1. Overview & Data Collected
overview.body: Oversea Store respects your privacy and is committed to protecting personal data. We collect only the data necessary to fulfill e-commerce transactions, secure account access, and maintain service availability:

items.account: Account Data: Username, email address, hashed password, phone number, and optional avatar URL upon registration.
items.order: Order & Fulfillment Data: Shipping address, customer name, contact phone number, items purchased, line-item pricing, and order status tracking.
items.session: Session & Security Data: HttpOnly session authentication cookies (no raw passwords or access tokens are stored in browser local storage).

usage.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
usage.body: Personal data collected by Oversea Store is strictly utilized for operational, fulfillment, and account governance purposes:

items.orders: Processing, fulfilling, and delivering customer orders.
items.security: Sending critical transactional order updates and OTP security codes for password reset or email verification.
items.governance: Enforcing role-based admin governance and protecting platform security.
items.compliance: Maintaining required legal and audit records for past commercial sales.

cookies.heading: 3. Cookies & Session Storage
cookies.body: Oversea Store uses essential cookies solely to maintain authenticated sessions via HttpOnly attributes. We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.

rights.heading: 4. User Rights & Account Deletion
rights.body: Users retain full rights to update their personal profile or request account deletion via the Profile page. When an account is deleted, the authentication credential record is permanently removed, while past order receipts are archived for legal accounting compliance.

help.title: Help Center & FAQ
help.description: Find answers to frequently asked questions or get in touch with support.

orders.title: Orders & Account
orders.q1: How do I track my order status?
orders.a1: You can track your order status by logging into your account and navigating to 'My Orders'. Each order displays live status updates and tracking details.
orders.q2: Can I modify or cancel an order after placing it?
orders.a2: Orders can be modified or canceled within 1 hour of placement. Please visit 'My Orders' or contact customer support immediately for assistance.
orders.q3: Do I need an account to place an order?
orders.a3: No, you can place orders as a guest. However, creating an account allows you to track orders easily, save wishlist items, and manage shipping addresses.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.q1: What are the standard shipping timelines?
shipping.a1: Standard domestic delivery takes 2 to 5 business days. Express delivery is available at checkout for 1-2 business day shipping.
shipping.a2: Yes, we offer free standard shipping on all domestic orders over $50.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.a1: We accept returns within 30 days of item delivery. Returned items must be unused, in original packaging, and with tags attached.
returns.q2: How long does a refund take to process?
returns.a2: Once your returned package is received and inspected, refunds are credited back to your original payment method within 3 to 7 business days.

payment.title: Payment & Pricing
payment.a1: We accept major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Cash on Delivery in supported regions.
payment.a2: Yes. All transactions are encrypted via 256-bit SSL encryption and processed through PCI-DSS compliant secure payment gateways.
